## Asian Giant Softshell Turtle (Pelochelys cantorii)

![Asian giant softshell turtle (Pelochelys cantorii)](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/0c/Pelochelys_cantorii.jpg)  
*Photo: Wikimedia Commons*

The Asian giant softshell turtle, also called Cantor’s giant softshell turtle (*Pelochelys cantorii*), is one of the largest freshwater turtles in Asia. Unlike hard-shelled turtles, it has a flattened, leathery carapace that helps it hide under sand or mud with only its snorkel-like snout exposed for breathing (IUCN). Adults can reach very large sizes—reports commonly note lengths around 1 meter in exceptional individuals—making it an important top predator in many river systems (IUCN; ADW).

This species lives in lowland freshwater habitats such as large rivers, lakes, and estuaries across parts of South and Southeast Asia, including India, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia (IUCN). It is highly aquatic and secretive, spending much of its time buried and ambushing prey. Its diet includes fish, crustaceans, mollusks, and other aquatic animals, reflecting its role as a generalist carnivore in muddy river environments (ADW).

Conservationists consider the Asian giant softshell turtle **Endangered**, largely due to habitat loss (river modification, sand mining, and wetland degradation) and heavy exploitation for meat and the wildlife trade (IUCN). Because it is difficult to detect in the wild and occurs at low densities, protecting nesting sites and reducing capture are especially important. In several countries, conservation programs now focus on surveys, habitat protection, and head-starting (raising young turtles before release) to improve survival (Turtle Conservancy).

![Pelochelys cantorii illustration/photo]((https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/7b/Pelochelys_cantorii_-_Cantor%27s_Giant_Softshell_Turtle.jpg))  
*Photo: Wikimedia Commons*

---

## Bibliography (MLA)

Animal Diversity Web. “*Pelochelys cantorii* (Asian Giant Softshell Turtle).” *University of Michigan Museum of Zoology*, https://animaldiversity.org/accounts/Pelochelys_cantorii/. Accessed 22 May 2026.

IUCN SSC Tortoise and Freshwater Turtle Specialist Group. “*Pelochelys cantorii*.” *The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species*, https://www.iucnredlist.org. Accessed 22 May 2026.

Turtle Conservancy. “Cantor’s Giant Softshell Turtle (*Pelochelys cantorii*).” *Turtle Conservancy*, https://www.turtleconservancy.org. Accessed 22 May 2026.
